capabilities: Convert pasted or selected URLs into embedded previews
Fetch link metadata via multiple parsers with fallback
Display favicons next to markdown links
Save embed images to the vault
disambiguation: Not for embedding local vault files; it turns external web URLs into preview cards.
extras: Some metadata parsers are rate-limited (MicroLink 50 requests/day, Iframely 1000/month) or require API keys; the default Local parser needs neither. Embeds since v2.0.0 are stored as code blocks, with a Convert button to migrate old embeds.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn an external URL into a rich preview card with title, image and favicon inside a note.

relations.evidence: Similar to the Link Favicons plugin, this plugin can display favicons next to regular markdown links

summary: URL embed plugin that converts pasted or selected web links into embedded preview cards rendered from code blocks.
